senses.gloss:
निज् {c3c} U. (नेनेक्ति, नेनिक्ते,
प्रणेनेक्ति, निक्त)
1 To wash, cleanse,
purify; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरंबराणि
Śi. 5. 28.
--2 To wash or clean oneself,
to be purified (A.).
--3 To nourish.
WITH निस् to wash, clean, purify;
R. 17. 22; Y. 1. 191; Ms. 5. 127.

निज a. [नितरां जायते निजण्-ड]
1
Innate, indigenous, native, inborn,
congenial.
--2 Own, one's own,
relating to one-self, of one's own party
or country; निजं वपुः पुनरनयन्निजां
रुचिं Śi. 17. 4; R. 3. 15, 18. 27;
Ms. 2. 50.
--3 Peculiar.
--4 Continual,
perpetual. --m. pl. One's own people.
